data.name: Chain Shirt (Base)
data.description: This extremely light chain shirt is made of very fine mithral links. The armor has an arcane spell failure chance of 10%%, a maximum Dexterity bonus of +6, and no armor check penalty. It is considered light armor.

source.original_ingest_defect: same-line 'DESC:.CLEAR' sentinel followed by a real DESC: token on the same corpus row; an earlier codegen pass captured only the .CLEAR sentinel (SD-25 criterion 7.N fix)
